text: Kate - knee op @ St Thomas' 14 Nov. home same day hopefully. text her eve before

coffee w/ Pieter Fri 10ish - Monmouth? confirm w/ him Thurs

Mehmet - dentist 10:30 tmrw then gym. Hates dentists
Victor = Vic. back op postponed again, now 19th Jan 2027. v fed up, can't sit long
send Aneesh the link to the physio guy
Felix got the job!! starts 4th Jan. take him for a pint

Dong's wedding off. he + Eva split end of Sept. he's ok-ish. ring him this wkend

Tobi applying to masters - KCL & Edinburgh. deadline 15 Jan. wants me to read personal statement
Keisha's sister Aoife - c-section booked 27/11, twins. K going up to Leeds to help
Valentina - prefers WhatsApp to calls. vegan. into bouldering

Kiri - redundancy mtg 30 Oct, whole team going. struggling, money tight, mortgage up in Jan. partner Dong on zero hrs contract so v stressful. she's applying for anything - 3 apps in already, NHS admin one closes 7/11. invite round for dinner next wk & send her the Civil Service jobs link
Sadia - tonsils out 5th Dec @ Royal Free. off 2 wks. ice lolly drop?
GP 8:40 Weds re ankle. pharmacy after
Xavier Moreau - recruiter @ Hays. said he'd send JD by Fri. chase Mon if nothing
Kate's bf Rhys - got 2nd interview. both v excited. K said he wants a new rucksack for trip, xmas idea
Fiona - nervous re her driving test 28th Oct. 3rd attempt. text good luck morning of
Kasia - started physio for shoulder. 2x/wk Tues + Fri till Xmas. slowly improving

Pieter's mum died last wk - very sudden, stroke. funeral Thurs 6 Nov 11am, Leicester crematorium, wake after @ the Cricketers. family asked no flowers, donations to Stroke Assoc instead. P seemed numb on phone, his sister Eva doing most of the arranging. send card + donation. ask Zainab if she's going, could share lift
Kevin & wife Lin - 10th anniv 12/12. going to Lisbon
Kieran - interview @ Arup 3 Nov 9:15. wants mock beforehand. sort Sun
call Sophie re Sat
Aidan - appendix out Sun night, emergency. still in Whittington, prob home Weds. his gf Salma there. drop grapes + mags tmrw after work. ask what ward
Luca's nan in hosp since 1st Oct - pneumonia. improving slowly. he's flying back to Turin 2 Nov to see her

Ben - finished chemo! last session 16 Oct, sent bell ringing vid to group. scan in 3 months (Jan) to confirm. still v tired, taste not back. his wife Lin says no visitors for couple wks, immune system. celebrate when he's up to it - he said curry, Dishoom. maybe early Dec
Mehmet + Kasia hosting housewarming Sat 8th Nov. bring wine. Mehmet doesn't drink tho - get him the alcohol free stuff

Victor's son Felix - uni interview @ Oxford, physics, 9th Dec. online this yr. Vic more nervous than him lol. F apparently v chill, been doing past papers. Vic asked if I'd do a practice chat w/ F since I did physics - said yes, sometime late Nov. message Vic w/ dates
Aneesh = Neesh. new role @ Monzo from 1st Dec, backend eng. leaving Revolut 28/11. leaving drinks?

Lars - ACL reconstruction finally booked 3 March 2027 @ Spire. waited since the injury in Aug. out of football whole season & can't cycle to work for ~3 months so wfh. gutted but relieved there's a date. his gf Valentina taking the wk off. must visit after, take the Switch so he's not bored
Eva - eye op went ok 13th. patch on 1 wk, can't drive. offered lifts to hosp follow up 20th

Ryan + Keisha visiting 22-24 Nov, arriving Fri late train. Sat: market, then Ryan wants the football. need to book table Sat night somewhere veggie (K strictly veggie, R eats anything). Sun brunch then they head off ~2. their anniv is that wk too (4 yrs 20/11?) - maybe cake
Valentina - Dr Ito appt 9 Dec re migraines. finally a referral after 2 yrs
Kiri's dog Bruno - op on leg Fri. £2k vet bill. she's stressed
Sadia's brother Sam - got into Manchester medicine, starts Sept 2027. Sadia so proud
ring Kate Sun - didn't get a chance to ask re results
dry cleaning, post office, return Amazon parcel. bins Thurs
Zainab's uncle Rashid had heart attack 4/11. stable, in Barts. Z staying near hosp. ask her what's useful - food? lifts? don't push
Kevin - final round @ Sky 18 Nov. presenting a 10 min deck. nervous about Q&A. offered to do practice run Weds 12th eve
Fiona Nguyen - new neighbour no. 14. nurse @ Guy's, night shifts. 2 kids. said pop over any time
Aoife - hip op scheduled 2 November 2026, recovery 6-8 wks. mum moving in to help. lent her my crutches - get back after. she loves crosswords, maybe a puzzle book
Rhys didn't get Deloitte. gutted but has KPMG interview 9/11. meet for drinks next wk
Lukas - bday 3 Dec. into vinyl, mentioned wanting the new Fontaines DC LP
Salma - hospital appt 14/05 got moved to 21/05, now 11:20. she asked me to come. I'm driving her
Lin - kid Ollie starts nursery Jan. Lin anxious about going back FT

Aidan Sato (from uni) - out of hospital 1st Oct after 2 wks, sepsis. long recovery. bumped into his sister Kiri @ Tesco on 18 Oct, said he's walking short distances now and bored stiff, keen for visitors. she said Sundays best, he's at his parents' till end of Nov. I should go w/ Luca, bring board games. maybe Sun 2 Nov or Sun 9th. text Kiri to confirm which

Keisha - applied to 6 grad schemes, 2 rejections so far, waiting on Unilever + BT. assessment centre @ BT 25/11. feeling flat about whole process, says everyone else has offers. remind her it's early. send her that CV template & offer to do mock interview the wk before
Felix's dad op - triple bypass booked 10 March 2027, Papworth. F taking 2 wks off. his mum in bits, Felix holding it together for her. don't forget to check in after

Mehmet - 2nd interview @ Google 6 Nov, 4 rounds back to back incl system design. said he's not sleeping. text good luck 5th eve, call after to see how it went. he likes Turkish delight - bring some Fri
